_language_note: Candidates are English-only working data in v1 and do not carry a 'language' field during review. The server adds language.source_language/localizations to the APPROVED record automatically at approval time (see server.py normalize_language() and data/approved-queue.example.json) — translation only ever happens after English approval, never during candidacy.
_headline_note: brief_headline is the AI-prepared AInetWatch editorial headline, human-approved before publication. headline is an alias for backward compatibility. original_headline is verbatim from the ingested source record; for unresolved Discovery Only leads it is the discovery-source headline, not the underlying article's own headline. source_resolution indicates whether the source is already the primary/original source ('resolved') or a discovery aggregator ('unresolved').
